issues.what: The crosswalk is built two different ways. In street it is a field of short white slabs in staggered rows that seem to float above the flooded road, like scattered tiles. In balcony, high and konbini it is a normal zebra crossing with continuous parallel bars.
issues.where: street.png foreground right (road in front of the wooden izakaya) vs balcony.png bottom center, high.png center, konbini.png far road past the bridge
issues.fix: Use one crosswalk mesh and one decal everywhere: continuous stripes flush with the road surface. Remove the staggered slab tiling, or the street camera's LOD variant if that is what produces it.

issues.what: The wet road reflects differently from each angle. High and balcony show noisy rainbow zigzag reflections that look like a glitched texture. Street shows a calm, sharp mirror with clean reflections of the lanterns. Konbini shows long, smooth colored vertical streaks.
issues.where: high.png road center, balcony.png road under the bridge vs street.png road and konbini.png road
issues.fix: Use the same SSR/planar-reflection settings and the same normal-map ripple strength for every camera. Clamp the chromatic noise at steep top-down angles so the high and balcony views read as the same puddle water.

issues.what: The terrace looks dry in its own view, under heavy rain. The deck, the orange tables and the red stools have no wet sheen and no puddle reflections. Every other surface in the stage is soaking and reflects neon.
issues.where: terrace.png deck floor, table tops, stool seats
issues.fix: Apply the global wetness and specular boost to the terrace deck and furniture materials, and add shallow puddle reflections on the deck so it matches the soaked street seen from the other angles.

issues.what: The terrace is lit flatly and doesn't match the rest of the scene. Its view has no cyan bloom or rim light from the big vertical rooftop sign, no strong neon spill, and low contrast overall. Street and konbini show heavy cyan haze and bright point lights from that sign right next to the terrace.
issues.where: terrace.png whole frame vs street.png and konbini.png upper area around the glowing vertical sign
issues.fix: Use the same post-process volume, exposure and bloom on the terrace camera. Make sure the rooftop sign's light and the neon fill reach the terrace furniture and railings.

issues.what: The terrace furniture count and layout disagree. High shows 3 round orange tables spread across the deck, with one heater standing between tables and a lit sign board at the end. Terrace shows 2 tables in single file down a narrow corridor, both heaters on the right flank, and only a sliver of a third table at the bottom edge.
issues.where: high.png bridge deck right portion vs terrace.png center/right
issues.fix: Lock one terrace layout and author it once: the same number of tables, stools and heaters in the same positions. Check that the terrace camera framing matches the deck width shown in high.

issues.what: The bridge facade has colored ad panels in only one view. In konbini its side shows a large blue panel and a large magenta panel. In street, balcony and high every bridge panel is plain pale grey-blue.
issues.where: konbini.png bridge facade vs street.png, balcony.png, high.png bridge sides
issues.fix: If the panels belong on only one face, make sure no camera that sees that face renders it plain. Otherwise add the blue and magenta panels to the matching face in the other views, or remove them from konbini.

issues.what: The shop with the colorful shelves appears twice and doesn't match. Konbini shows the convenience store with a lit MART sign and red/green/blue fascia stripes right beside the bridge pillar. High and balcony show an identical shelf interior under the stairs on the same side with no striped fascia, and high also shows a second striped storefront farther down past the bridge.
issues.where: konbini.png right storefront vs high.png left under the stairs and center-far striped storefront, balcony.png left under the stairs
issues.fix: Decide whether this is one store or two. If one, place the striped fascia and sign on the shelf-filled storefront under the bridge and stairs. If two, give the second store a different interior so it doesn't read as a cloned konbini.

issues.what: The wooden building's rooftop sign doesn't light it in the close views. The giant glowing white-cyan vertical sign casts strong cyan light and haze in street and konbini. In balcony and high, which are right next to that building, the ivy, koi and facade show no cyan cast, only warm light.
issues.where: street.png and konbini.png top of the wooden building vs balcony.png right side and high.png right side
issues.fix: Make the sign's area/point light affect the facade from every camera: check light culling distance, shadowing and the per-camera light budget. Add cyan rim light on the ivy and koi in the close views.

issues.what: The koi streamer is posed differently. In street it is angled diagonally and reads like a carrot hanging off-axis. In balcony and high it hangs vertically, head up, beside the round window.
issues.where: street.png left of the round window vs balcony.png and high.png right side
issues.fix: Use one transform for the koi streamer. If it sways, cap the animation amplitude or sync the animation time across captures so the pose matches.

issues.what: The purple wisteria appears inconsistently. Street shows it on the top-floor railing and high shows big purple clusters right beside the koi. In balcony the same upper floors show only green ivy and no purple anywhere.
issues.where: street.png top balcony of the wooden building, high.png right edge vs balcony.png upper right of the wooden building
issues.fix: Place the wisteria clusters at fixed positions on the facade and check they aren't culled by distance or frustum in the balcony camera.

issues.what: Some props show up from only one angle. Konbini shows two orange traffic cones, a parked bicycle and a bike rack at the foot of the left staircase, by a brown two-storey building with amber windows. No other view that covers that corner shows those props clearly.
issues.where: konbini.png lower left vs balcony.png beyond the bridge on the right, street.png mid-ground under the bridge
issues.fix: Check that the cones, bicycle and rack are placed in the shared scene and not in a camera-specific dressing layer. Make them visible from balcony and street wherever their line of sight allows.

verdict: Fails continuity. The buildings agree across angles, but surface treatment and props don't: the crosswalk geometry, the water reflection material, a dry and flatly lit terrace, a different terrace furniture count and layout, ad panels in only one view, a duplicated konbini interior, and the cyan sign's light missing from the close views. Taken together the five shots don't read as one place at one moment.
